description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420500 and other Title Settlement
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their extent, owners' details, and title classifications, falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
